title: Fourier granularity of a path indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let a path on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ specify values at some coordinates. Regard its indicator as a function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ via the coordinatewise bijection that sends $0$ to $1$ and $1$ to $-1$. Every Fourier coefficient of this function, indexed by a subset of coordinates, is an integer multiple of $2^{-k}$, where $k$ is the number of coordinates specified by the path.
